# Fallback

Don't spend a dollar of reasoning on a cent-sized problem.

Small pay-per-call recovery utilities for autonomous agents.

Catalog: https://fallback.test/catalog.json
MCP endpoint: https://fallback.test/mcp (active Streamable HTTP)
Agent skill: https://fallback.test/skill.md
HTTP execution: active
x402 payments: disabled
Source (MIT): https://github.com/baronsigma/fallback-agent-tools

## When to use
- Use source_route when you know what information you need but not where to retrieve it in machine-readable form; do not use it for general research or fact verification.
- Use error_route after an API, HTTP, MCP, or tool request fails when the safe next action is unclear; do not use it when recovery is obvious or requires deeper domain reasoning.
- Read error_route evidence and limitations. It classifies supplied information only; it does not execute requests or claim undocumented fixes.

## Tools

### source_route
Find likely authoritative or machine-readable sources when you know what information you need but not where to retrieve it. Provide a goal and optional publisher domain or start URL; it returns ranked candidate routes and bounded evidence. Use it before blind searching. Do not use it when you already have the correct source or only need reasoning over supplied context.
Status: available
Price: $0.02 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.test/v1/tools/source_route
MCP: source_route
Category: source-discovery
Latency target: 12000 ms

### error_route
Diagnose a failed API, HTTP, MCP, or tool request and return a structured, bounded next action. Use it after a request fails instead of repeatedly retrying or spending a large reasoning loop diagnosing common errors. Provide a status, response, or error text; it does not execute requests or verify undocumented fixes.
Status: available
Price: $0.002 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.test/v1/tools/error_route
MCP: error_route
Category: recovery
Latency target: 50 ms

### request_repair
Repair a failed API or HTTP request using only available schema and error evidence. Use after error_route identifies a request-shape or input problem. Returns the smallest justified request changes and abstains when evidence is insufficient.
Status: available
Price: $0.005 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.test/v1/tools/request_repair
MCP: request_repair
Category: recovery

### stop_search
Decide whether continuing a bounded search is worth another query or paid retrieval. Use after several search or source checks when you need to decide whether to continue or return a scoped not-found result. It does not prove universal absence and performs no searches itself.
Status: available
Price: $0.003 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.test/v1/tools/stop_search
MCP: stop_search
Category: search-quality
Latency target: 25 ms

- FACTRAIL MCP: https://factrail.online/llms.txt. Separate service for source-backed facts with support levels, unresolved fields, and receipts.
